subject: Warm handoff: Solstice Health — implementation kickoff and owners
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Morales <evan.morales@solsticehealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@solsticehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Warm handoff: Solstice Health — implementation kickoff and owners

Hi Monica / Marissa,

Thanks again for partnering on this — Solstice signed the SOW this morning and they want to move quickly. Below is a concise summary and the asks to get the kickoff scheduled. I put the external contacts on for visibility.

Deal highlights
- ACV: $420k/year; 12-month term (standard enterprise)
- Primary use: clinical triage routing + patient message summarization (low PII surface)
- Target go-live: 2026-08-09 (requested by their operations lead)

Technical constraints & notes
- They require SSO (SAML) and audit log export to our S3 bucket per the SOW (see SOW_v3 attached).
- Data locality: US only.
- Expected peak: 30 concurrent inference sessions, median latency target < 350ms per token.

Success criteria (what they told us)
1) 95% availability during business hours
2) end-to-end triage latency within agreed SLA
3) 30-day reduction in manual triage load measured by their ticketing system

Immediate asks for CS:
- Can you own the kickoff and nominate primary implementation lead?
- Please confirm SSO owner and if we need our Security Engineering for the initial call.
- Proposed first-call window: Wed 2026-06-23 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 2026-06-24 09:00–10:00 PT.

Attachments: SOW_v3_Solstice.pdf, solstice-implementation-checklist.xlsx
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/87654321/RW-2026-0887

Thanks — I can join the kickoff for initial context.

Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(k) 415-555-0198

Thanks Karthik — congrats team. I'll take primary ownership for the implementation.

Quick plan and owners (initial):
- Monica Patel (primary CS lead) — onboarding cadence, acceptance criteria, exec syncs
- Marissa Cole (solutions engineering) — technical integration, SSO, preflight tests
- Security Eng (TBD) — brought in if SAML metadata exchange requires adjustments to our IdP config

Action items I will own this week:
- Send a kickoff agenda and invite by EOD Tuesday (inc. pre-kickoff checklist).
- Review SOW_v3 and flag any technical open items (I'll annotate the checklist).
- Confirm internal SSO contact and whether we need a Security Eng on the first call (ETA Tue 12:00 PT).

Evan / Priya — thanks for signing. Which of the proposed windows works best? Also, can you share the SAML metadata (or IdP contact) prior to the call?

Monica

Monica — I can lead the technical portion of the kickoff and run through the SSO steps; I'll also validate the audit export config with infra during the call. Karthik — happy to stay on for the first 30 min to hand over context.

See you all Thu.
